mission.title: Combat Run
mission.description: Take the General's enhanced weapons and his commandos on a combat run against the Merovingian's Exiles.

npc.say: I-I'll go straight! I swear! Back to Zion!

Don't worry about that Cypherite crap, or people who say we can't trust the General. We've got the people, the skills, and the firepower to win this war, and that's all that matters. Don't you forget it.
The Captain has a lot of faith in your abilities, soldier. Don't let her down.
Captain Niobe doesn't give out compliments like that to just anyone. Keep this up and you'll be going places.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, now that we have the General's enhanced anti-Exile weapons, it's time to ramp up the offensive against the Merovingian's organization. I hope that you have saved some of your new weapons for this important mission.
Begin your combat run at the location indicated.

enter.say: I've got some signals in there--but they're redpills, not Exiles. If they're aligned with the Merovingian, maybe we can get the location of some Exiles out of them.

talk.say: D-don't hurt me! I only just joined the Merovingian's organization yesterday! It was all a huge mistake! Look, you want Exiles, right? I know where you can find some. J-just go to the address on this note.

done.say: Sounds like we can get some info out of that guy. See what he's got.

objective.text: Get the note with the address from Rabbit

talk.say: You want Exiles, right? I know where you can find some. J-just go to the address on this note.

done.say: I know that address. Let's go hit it. Don't worry; if it isn't legit, we'll track that wimp down and teach him not to try lying to Zion.

phase.briefing:
Scanning that address... We have a positive ID on Exile readings at that location, operative. Procee-- Just a moment, I'm getting a priority transmission. ...
{player}, that was our liaison with the General. He's been monitoring your progress against the enemy, and he's placed a squad of his commandos at your disposal for this assault. I'm uploading the squad's location to you now. Rendezvous with them before proceeding against the Exile group.

enter.say: I've got commando readings in there, all right. Looks like our boys.

talk.say: It's a honor to have this chance to work with you, sir!
The Merovingian had better watch out now, sir.

objective.text: Lead Paris, Salcedo and Ezell out of the area

phase.briefing: This is a significant nest of the Merovingian's Exiles, operative. Make good use of the commandos provided by the General.

enter.say: Exiles. Lots of 'em. I'm just gonna close my eyes, and you let me know when it's okay to look.

done.say: I can look now? Oh, good. Yep, all clear in there.
Thank you, sir! My orders are to remain here and secure this location!
No Exiles remaining in the target area, sir!

phase.briefing: Stand by, soldier. Captain Niobe is jacked in, and wants to speak with you. Uploading her location now. I wouldn't keep her waiting, {player}.

enter.say: I've got Niobe and a couple other redpill signals in there.

talk.say: Hey, operative. I was monitoring you, and I liked what I saw today. You've been doing a fine job of working with the General's forces and handling the Merv's Exiles. It's good to know I've got people like you I can count on in this war. I may even have a few special missions for you down the road. Keep your eyes peeled and you'll do all right.

done.say: I think that's your cue to take off, {player}.

mission.finish: Warrior, a personal commendation from Captain Niobe is one of the highest honors I can think of. Anything I can say pales by comparison, but I hope you don't mind if I add that it's a pleasure working as your controller. I just know that if we can keep up this level of success, Zion will win the freedom she is fighting for, and bring peace to the Matrix.
